nom: TULA So Poreless Deep Exfoliating Scrub

avis.texte: Honestly, this didnt do it for me. It smell is great. I feel like the exfoliant "beads" are too large and didnt really get in there and get rid of dead skin. I didn't feel like my face was clean and soft like I expected. The price is also too high. I wouldn't repurchase.
This scrub left my skin feeling super clean! I wish you got more product for the price.
Feels good on the skin, i think it has helped with my pores so far. Definitely helps with removing dead skin.

I love how this scrub makes my face feel refreshed and clean. I use it a couple times a week and don't feel like it is too aggravating or drying. I use after removing makeup but before my regular cleanser.
I love this poreless exfoliation scrub! My skin feels so smooth and now my skincare and makeup look and feel so much better!

avis.titre: Esti here who loves this stuff:)
avis.texte: love love love tula!! only skincare that always keeps my skin looking like glass. I love how this exfoliant is gentle and feels almost like a jelly but you can also still feel it exfoliating leaving you with super smooth skin. I would highly recommend this product to everyone.

avis.titre: Love the smell and it wor
avis.texte: Love the smell and it works great. First time using this TULA product, happy with results.
I'm loving this scrub. It leaves my face feeling clean, smooth and fresh.
Absolutely love this product. It doesn't dry out my skin and it makes my face smooth. Definitely recommend this to all of my friends and family.

i have had this product since April. I dont exfoliate my skin alot due to sensitivity. but this literally does nothing and you have to use alot for it to feel like its somewhat cleaning your skin . if you want an exfoliate I recrecommend goodmocules .

I got this upon wanting to swap exfoliators and I was very excited because I had heard very good things about this brand. This product is utterly useless. My skin is reactive and so I try and stay away from overly harsh or abrasive exfoliators, but this is so under-exfoliating that it's comical. I've seen no change what-so-ever in my skin since using this and I've tried using the recommended amount and double that. I wouldn't waste your money on this, it's disappointing. You shouldn't have to use double or triple the recommended amount of a product to get sub-par results.
Great deep exfoliating scrub! Smells so good and gives the skin a nice glow and softness. I use it one or twice a week.

I'm disappointed that i threw the box out before trying this product, i would have returned it. I've noticed no visible difference in the appearance of my skin or the softness. It also seems to take a ton of product to get it spread evenly over your face. One pro is that my very sensitive skin didnt have a negative reaction from this scrub.

avis.titre: Really nice wash for an o
avis.texte: Really nice wash for an older woman love how my face feel after I'm done washing it
I LOVE the deep exfoliating scrub. I am 66 and I my skin feels softer. My husband even complimented how my skin looked healthy.
This stuff is the best scrub ever. It makes your body smooth as ice! A little goes a long way. For those pesky little bumps you get here and there this will smooth them over!

So i finished this today and i wanted to wait to write a review until i finished it. the scrub aspect is great if you like gritty scrubs! however, i never saw much of a difference in pores or overall skin conditions. i have combo skin and it could totally be for the fact its just not that good for my skin type. still, i think it smells nice and has the texture that i like! also, it didnt make my skin worse so i guess thats a plus!

This product was too smooth for me. If I am using a scrub I want to feel it. There is nothing wrong with the product but it wasn't for me. It's a gel consistency and glides onto the skin nicely but I didn't feel like it was doing anything because I couldn't feel it.
Love this product. It is great to use in the shower before the rest of my skincare routine.
I do like this brand however I did return this product because it was way to harsh on my skin, it was like rubbing sand paper on your face.

This product was recommended by an esthetician who was working PT at Ulta. I will always buy this product! I was having problems with breakouts and when I used it, GONE! I love the way it leaves my skin feeling and looking! Use cold water to rinse.

avis.titre: Love this! Has a great fe
avis.texte: Love this! Has a great feeling after you wash it off. The scrub feels nice and it has a citrus scent. Leaves skin feeling soft and smooth.
Reduced my pores, makes my skin feel great & smells good, too!

I've tried a few Tula products in the past and didn't really care for any of them BUT I keep going back and trying others. I purchased this scrub along with a few other items and I'm not impressed. The scrub barely has any "scrub" to it. The smell is fine. The amount of product you get for the price is pathetic. This also leaves a film on my face and my skin feels anything but clean and exfoliated. I think I have finally learned my lesson. No more Tula for me.

avis.titre: AVOID AT ALL COST IF YOU HAVE SENSITIVE SKIN
avis.texte: It has been 2 weeks and my irritation still very bad. I only used it omce for less than 2 minutes. At first, it gave both my face and neck redness and irritation. The irritation on my face went away after 1.5 weeks. BUT it does not go away on my neck, I couldnt sleep at night at all. I know I have senstive skin, but I did not expect this. Please be careful!

I have pretty much always been consciously aware of my oily skin and larger pores, This is the one product that actually delivered fast and effective results. I am 48 so it is more common I think to have dry skin issues, With having PCO's however my oily skin seems to persist. I can honestly say that this and other Tula products have worked very well with my skin type, This one is my go-to favorite and I consider it my holy grail.
Feels like your adding a think layer of product on and need to use another face wash to clean your face afterwards. Won't use this at all.
Smells great and is a great exfoliant. Leaves skin feeling fresh and clean. Unsure of the effect on pores since I use a few different products.

The 1st time I was surprised how clean my face smelt after. I'm always on the look for a good exfoliate scrub to add to my skincare collection and this marks all the boxes. I combo it with my cleanser and love the results. My face smells amazing. So glad the website recommend this for me after I took the quiz.
One of the best exfoliates I have ever used! Love love love!!

I waited to write the review until i used it for a while, but i noticed improvements after the first or second use. It made my skin look smooth and glowy, to the point that i felt like i could leave the house without any makeup on. It is a small container, but it lasts a while since it recommends 2-3 times per week. I just purchased again.
Ever since using this product my skin is much smoother and it feels really good when using it every couple days. I always look forward to exfoliating my face.

I was really wanting to like this scrub, but I feel like there hasn't been any change in terms of my blackheads. my pores are still pretty large & blackheads are prominent. it does however make my skin feel smooth and soft, and feels nice scrubbing it on my face.
I Was hesitant to try an exfoliating scrub because i have sensitive skin. But this product was amazing and i have noticed a difference in my skin by just 2 uses. And this product smells good!

This product is AMAZING! It made my face feel so smooth after using it just one time! I've been using it a few times a week and love it. My face feels cleaner as well. This was my first Tula skincare and to say I'm obsessed and extremely impressed is an understatement. I'll definitely be rebuying this exfoliate as well as other products.
Love all products by TULA but this isn't my favorite cleanser out of them all!
Using this scrub in my skincare routine has significantly reduced the number of visible blackheads.
Makes my skin feel extra soft & bright! It smells juicy, & a little bit goes a long way. Great addition to my tula regimen.
This works so well for my sensitive skin & is very gentle.
Love this product! The smell is amazing and I love that it's a scrub that's not too drying.
Love the feel of the product. Feels much like a salon facial!
It's really cleaned my pores out. My face looks a thousand times better
I love this scrub! I feel it has really made my skin much smoother and clearing my pores! I also really enjoy the scent of this scrub. I will be purchasing again!
This is the perfect amount of exfoliation- my skin feels so soft after. The smell is nice too!

avis.titre: great at getting rid go black heads
avis.texte: The products does a beautiful job of decreasing the look and size of blackheads and pores. It is a product I will purchase again!

I was initially going to purchase the other exfoliate which is thensugar dcrub. But i noticed my pores needed more attention and were only getting worse. I gave this a try for 3 weeks and noticed a change in my pores and texture. It has made my pores slightly minimized and feeling so much cleaner. I do wish this was bigger for the price!
This will bring out all the youthful skin! Nice glow and plumpness!
I have sensitive skin and was worried this would be too rough, but it's really creamy and gentle. My skin looks great after use. I love it and will definitely be buying it again.
Removes blackheads better than any product I've ever tried! Smells amazing and leaves skin so smooth without irritation! And you see instant results with it!
This leaves my skin feeling so soft and smooth, and my breakouts have gotten so much better. Smells like candy!

Absolutely love this product. I've been using it for 2 weeks now along with the acne cleanser, gel, and moisturizer and my acne is completely under control! I actually like to use this first and then before washing it off add on the cleanser on top. It works wonders!
My skin seriously feels so soft after putting this on. I am on an acne uphill battle at the moment and the Skin Quiz recommended I buy this and let me just say I am so excited I did.
I am obsessed with this exfoliant. Aside from it making my skin feel insanely soft, the smell alone is reason to buy! It smells SO good.
This product has made my skin feel like butter. I am in love and will purchase again.
Skin feels so soft and extra clean. The perfect refresher for you face. Love the little scrub beads inside, whatever that is, it's perfect! Soft glowing skin is the end result!
The best scrub ever. My pores look cleaned and my skin feels so smooth.
Skin has felt softer and clearer as I have used this! Really like it!

This product clears up pores and leaves skin feeling soft. My black heads cleared up about a week after using. I would use it every other day for the first week and then about twice a week. Great product!
My skin feels so clean after I use this! I love it! It's better than any other cleanser I have tried!
Ok but not quite enough exfoliating power for my skin. Make my skin flake even more instead of removing dead skin.
Skin looks amazing after use, it feels clean and refreshing. The size feels great.

I have sensitive, combination, acne prone skin. I use this 2 times a week and love how it exfoliates and helps clear up flaky skin from healed blemishes. It smells nice, and doesn't irritate my skin at all. I do wish there was a little more in the container, but it doesn't take much for each use.

I tried it because it was half off. I would not pay full price for this product. It does leave my skin soft if I have dry skin on my nose but that's it's. I don't see any other difference in my pores nor blackheads. I had high hopes for this product because of the reviews, but didn't do much for me after using for 2 months.
I always get nervous trying out scrubs due to my skin but this is amazing. It's not too rough, it warms while using and smells great. I use 3x a week and have noticed an improvement
My blackheads are not gone. Had a lot of hope for this product, too. I use this as directed and have been using it for like 2 months.

avis.titre: Must try for acne prone skin!
avis.texte: This product has worked for me since I first used it. It has a gentle exfoliation and brightens my skin after use. It has left my skin clearer with no noticable pores. It's a must try if you struggle with acne, I'm 22 and I have flare ups occasionally and this product is great. I use it about 3x a week.

avis.titre: The Best Tula product for me
avis.texte: This exfoliator is worth the hype. Gentle on sensitive skin, helps with nose and chin pores. Doesn't dry out your skin after using either.
I love this exfoliating scrub! One of my favorites! Definitely will repurchase!
I love this scrub it really makes my skin feel better and smoother right after and I'm definitely purchasing again:)

I've heard great things about Tula. I was excited to try your products, esp this one because it smells super nice! Everytime I use this scrub, my face gets splotchy red and dry spots. Instead of improving my skin, this scrub makes it worse.
This is honestly the best smelling skincare product I've purchased! The scrub really helps smooth the skin and feels really good on the face.
Leaves my sling super soft and I can actually see the difference. It does not irritate my skin. Would definitely recommend
Fantastic scrub. My face feels so revitalized when I use it. It exfoliates perfectly, all dirt is gone, and it smells great!
This product is lightweight and gentle, yet leaves my skin feel clean and smooth. It's absolutely amazing!
This is amazing in the shower. Easy to open, no irritation and I feel super clean. My pores look amazing.
The smell is AMAZING. Makes my pores cry and shrivel up. The grit to this is perfect, not too harsh but still effective.

The banana pudding exfoliating scrub works very well! It smells great and feels great going on your skin as you rub it in! It doesn't take a whole lot to cover your body with but I always like to overuse it a little more! Then I'm completely covered every where! It's even everywhere! So I scrub it all in area by area and at the end I will then wash off all that is left on my body and rub it in and wash it all away this last time! And I feel great all that dead skin from the day is gone and I can slip into my gown and into my bed for a great night s sleep! So relaxed! Good night ! Again tomorrow night!
Works great in conjunction with other TULA products, and it smells SO GOOD!

My teen daughter inherited her father's extra large pores. Her nose stayed bumpy and pores were visibly clogged. After one use, she came running exclaiming, "It works! My nose is smooth!!" Her face is much brighter and the clogged pores have diminished almost 100%. I bought this at half price to test the product. We will definitely be a repeat customer at full value.
I needed something to really scrub and this does extremely well. My face felt noticeably softer and my makeup looked better.
Love this product however the cost will only allow me to use it on special occasions as there are more affordable options out there that are similar.
Works nicely leaving my skin soft and looking fresh. Smells so clean and my sensitive skin really appreciates this product.
I'm 2 weeks in using twice a week and my problem area is my nose. My pores are much clearer and not getting painful irritated black heads anymore.
I love the smell and the smooth feeling on the skin. I am not sure it has enough roughness to get rid of blackheads. I wish it has a little more scrubbing power! Hence the 4 star.
I prefer the so polished tula sugar scrub to this one. This scrub has a sticky slimy texture and I do not care for the smell.
I don't find it very abrasive, as soon as you start rubbing it around it just goes away, I feel like I would need to use a lot to get the level of exfoliation I want. Smells good.
Amazing how smooth my skin is after exfoliation. You only need a small amount.

Just purchased this product as it was 50% off, a deal I couldnt pass up. I have other TULA products so I wasnt expecting to be disappointed which i sure wasnt. I started with using a mild cleanser by CeraVe and then finished with this exfoliate. My face felt extremely clean and soft the moment i washed the product off. The beads werent harsh/rough on the skin at all. I wish I got more than 1 bottle when the promo was still active but I will repurchase in the future. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!
I thought it was going to help with my blackheads but it felt like I was just putting oil on my face . It's smelled amazing but was not a good exfoliate scrub .
Love!! The beads are wonderful. Leaves me feeling clean & refreshed. Smells amazing too 10/10
I love how it cleans my face. It leaves it looking smooth and my pours seem smaller. Love it
The exfoliating scrub was exactly what I was looking for! Gently, yet tough on my dry skin spots.
I've used this a couple times a week for about a month and it's an okay product.

avis.titre: I want to love it but…
avis.texte: It leaves a weird residue like feel on my face. Also the particles it that are meant to exfoliate are super abrasive even with a light lather. I love Tula but this is a no. I recommend their so smooth fruit enzyme mask instead
